show.description: Father's Last Wish is a romantic drama about Reet, a hardworking young woman who unknowingly falls for her late father's best friend and boss, Kartik Mehta - a powerful billionaire. What starts as a mentorship turns into love, betrayal, and redemption, as hidden truths, class differences and a toxic ex threaten to destroy their bond and their chance at happiness.
